_doc: residents.sc settings. lobby = the block box an unregistered player may stand in (inclusive block coords);
return = where they are put back when the position is nonsense (wrong height). role = the one fixed look of
registered regular players (a scoreboard team colour, no symbol, adventure mode). Ops, exempt names/patterns and
Carpet fake players are never held. seed = players registered automatically on first start.
rules: Do not break or take from other people's builds.
Ask before you change something that is not yours.
Build tidily: no pits and holes in the ground.
Something broken or unclear? Ask an admin.
